note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1958: nominations 20 May 1958; six contests, polled 5 June 1958. The outgoing member in Moyra Castle was deemed re-elected. Labels as printed in the Newry Telegraph nominations list. Polled 5 June 1958. Trainor was the outgoing member. Richardson, M.P. for South Armagh, announced his withdrawal on 27 May, too late to be removed from the ballot, and forfeited his deposit.
